title: Fambot Targets the Operational Burden of Family Life
dek: The startup is building an AI assistant designed to coordinate the emails, calendars and school-and-sports logistics that consume family time.
socialCaption: Fambot is taking aim at the overlooked workflow of family logistics: school emails, calendars, sports schedules and the constant coordination around them. Its challenge is not just AI capability—it is accuracy, trust and fitting into how families already operate.
